During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Pharl McQuarrie/Legends|Pharl McQuarrie]] commanded a [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|refitted]] '''''Consular''-class cruiser'''. McQuarrie and the [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|cruiser]] served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Battle of Ukio|defense]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] in the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the war.<ref name="Act on Instinct" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
McQuarrie's ''Consular''-class cruiser appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' webcomic ''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]'', published on [[StarWarsKids.com]] from [[2009]] to [[2010]].<ref name="Act on Instinct" />
